question: outcome_summary
answer: The study aims to evaluate the effects of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) on suicide risk and related behaviors through a network meta-analysis. It will focus on mean changes in suicidality assessment scores over the first two months of SSRI treatment, utilizing various scales. The analysis will compare five SSRIs and assess weekly suicide risk using standardized mean differences and odds ratios. Findings are expected to inform clinical practice regarding SSRIs and their timing in relation to suicide risk.
